# Output kinds

What a floe emits that no other floe asks for. A signature is answered
by one provider and read by whoever holds the hole; a kind is collected
from everyone who writes it and read by the distribution. ADR 0008 is
which of the two a thing should be.

<!-- Generated by nix/kind-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

## Every kind

| kind | as | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [catallaxy.cd](./cd.md) | `cd` | How the lab's manifests reach its clusters, and the root Application that hands one over. |
| [catallaxy.cluster](./cluster.md) | `clusterDescriptor` | How a cluster is created and who fronts it — the descriptor `cata` builds it from. |
| [catallaxy.component](./component.md) | `component` | What a floe installs into a cluster: bundles, and the operator surface around them. |
| [catallaxy.dnsInfo](./dnsInfo.md) | `dnsInfo` | Where the lab's resolver answers, as `cata lab dns` configures the host. |
| [catallaxy.labSecrets](./labSecrets.md) | `labSecrets` | Every secret the lab holds, keyed by the name the CLI knows it as. |
| [catallaxy.labServices](./labServices.md) | `labServices` | Every host service the lab runs, keyed by the name the CLI knows it as. |
| [catallaxy.labSteps](./labSteps.md) | `labSteps` | Every plan step the lab's floes contribute, keyed by step name. |
| [catallaxy.labStores](./labStores.md) | `labStores` | Every store the lab reads authored secret values from, keyed by the name the CLI knows it as. |
| [catallaxy.networkPolicy](./networkPolicy.md) | `networkPolicy` | That something in this cluster enforces a NetworkPolicy, and what implements it. |
| [catallaxy.projections](./projections.md) | `projections` | Secrets a cluster asks `cata` to fill from a lab store. |
| [catallaxy.publications](./publications.md) | `publications` | Where a resource's output lands once it exists, as an address in a lab secret store. |
| [catallaxy.resources](./resources.md) | `resources` | Infrastructure declared for a state-based tool to create, for the case no cluster can own it. |
| [catallaxy.routedHosts](./routedHosts.md) | `routedHosts` | Hostnames the lab's ingress routes, keyed by the cluster that serves them. |
